Sandbox_BetterContainers_ProximityEnable: Enables the Proximity Inventory system for this server.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_ForceCorpseOnly: Forces Proximity Inventory to operate in corpse-only mode. Players cannot switch modes.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AllowToggleProx: Allows players to enable or disable Proximity Inventory via keybind or mod options.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AllowSwitchMode: Allows players to switch between all-containers mode and corpse-only mode.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AutoLockEnabled: Enables the Auto-Lock feature. When active, Proximity Inventory will snap back to the selected container unless intentionally changed.
Sandbox_BetterContainers_AllowToggleAuto: Allows players to enable or disable Auto-Lock via mod options.
